stp-active:
bridge 'lab-bridge' prio 21524 mac 00:00:5e:00:53:01 vd 'lab-vdom'
root prio 21524 mac 00:00:5e:00:53:01 cost 0
port 'port1' role designated state forward cost 2000 edge yes rx 3 tx 136
virtual-switch:
config system virtual-switch
    edit "VLAN10"
        set physical-switch "sw0"
        set vlan 10
        config port
            edit "internal1"
            next
            edit "internal2"
            next
        end
    next
end
switch-interfaces:
name: internal1   type: physical   trunk: disable
name: internal2   type: physical   trunk: disable
name: internal5   type: physical   trunk: enable
